parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: ImageDigest
parameters.description:
The image digest.
> Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
Sets the language type for request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paginated query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container image instance.
> You can call the [ListRepository](~~451339~~) operation of Container Registry to obtain the container image instance ID from the **InstanceId** response parameter.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description:
The name of the image repository.
> Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: RepoNamespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the image repository.
> Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the file. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

- **high**: High risk.
- **medium**: Medium risk.
- **low**: Low risk.

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description:
The collection of scan scopes. Valid values:

- **image**: Image.
- **container**: Container.
